details:
On VRChat friending someone is actually a very personal act,  it gives another person the ability to access you in friend worlds, to know when your online and in what world unless you hide yourself,  it also allows them to bypass your safety settings.
For some people with small groups this is fine but if you have hundreds if not thousands of friends it can be difficult to mange this list even more so if you end up pruning that list and end up harming the feelings of people who you might not have met in a long while but suddenly are unfriended by you.
Its also the name friended.  They might just be acquaintance rather than friend so it can be awkward to request a friend from them.
So I thought how about this.  We can favourite worlds so out of all the 50k plus worlds we have a list of select bunch that we follow,  how about the ability to favourite people from the unknown millions that have a VRChat account.
Its basically a tag on a person that you have favourited them,  all this actually does is provide a notice to you on there tag that you favourited them maybe a small star with a f in it. Also it would be nice if they could see that you have favourited them as well maybe a small circle with an f in it.  If both of you favourite each other you see a small circle with a star around it with an f in the middle no need to have more than one icon for this.
Also you dont need permission to favourite someone unlike friending them as everything favourite a person does is passive not active.
Also add a list of people who you have favourited as well to the social page.
On that persons profile get some extra options which is the real meat of this suggestion.
You can add a small personal note the size of a twitter maybe,  so you can avoid the awkward situation of meeting someone who you favourited a while ago but have no idea where or when or why.  With this note you can add stuff like met at the pug they where a dancer.  Or they made a great world I like. Etc
Next add two small tick boxes.  The first one lets you get world updates from this person,  say you find a world you really like so you favourite the world creator,  there not going to accept a random friend request from you but you should be able to favourite them and thick the world update box so you can be notified if they update one of there worlds or release a new one ill explain how shortly.
The next tick box is Show status.  The status box is very underutilised in VRChat, it has the ability to provide a lot of information to a lot of people simultaneously if presented correctly.
In the new menu add a new page called notification just before info.
On this page there are tabs on the side,  one is Friend Updates which shows a list in order of date of notifications of worlds that are either updated or newly released by your friends.   The truth is we dont actually have the ability to see this information that vrchat already has and can provide to us in a list format.
Next tab is Friends Status.  This shows a list of the status of your friends by date updated.  This is a quick way of seeing all the status of your friends in one go.  What news or info or memes they want to put in there status,  it will also make the status feature more important to people.
Next tab is Favourite Updates,  this shows a combination of updates and notifications of all worlds you favourited and all people you favourited and ticked there update notification tick box on there profile,  maybe you only want to know the world release and update status of a few people who you favourite.
Last tab is Favourite Status,  here you get to see the status of all the people who you favourite and ticked there status update box on there profile.  This will be very hand to world makers if there fans favourite them.
I think that is it.  Any thoughts, improvements or other suggestions to the suggestion of been able to favourite people.
title: The ability to favourite people
